# Third-party source checkouts

`llama.cpp/` is a local, Git-ignored clean checkout used for source auditing and
private FIT integration work.

Initial pinned revision:

```text
4e97ac86ebe2c4cb8212d98d2641ad6768810896
```

This matches the supplied build-10666 ROCm runtime. FIT does not modify or
submit changes to upstream during M1.
